events.title: Brent settles at $91.95 on US stock build while Hormuz attacks continue
events.summary: Brent fell $1.19 to $91.95 on 18 Nov after EIA crude stocks rose 3.4 mb; attacks on Hormuz shipping, US-Iran strikes and Houthi drone strikes on Saudi East-West pipeline limited losses. Both benchmarks on track for ~20% monthly declines.

events.title: China chemical futures sell off: styrene -2%, benzene, propylene, PX over -3%
events.summary: Domestic commodity futures closed mostly lower on 18 Nov; styrene fell more than 2% and pure benzene, propylene and PX more than 3%, signalling weaker aromatics and acrylic feedstock costs.

events.title: Shandong 200 kt/y PO/SM unit restarted feed
events.summary: A 200 kt/y PO/SM styrene unit in Dongming, Shandong restarted feedstock on 10 Nov and is expected to produce on-spec product soon, adding supply as styrene futures weaken.

events.title: Shandong solvent oil weak on bearish fundamentals
events.summary: Mysteel's 18 Nov solvent-oil review (headline 'fundamentals remain bearish, solvent oil weak') put Shandong national-standard solvent oil at 8,200-8,300 CNY/t and naphtha trades at 8,393 (-135).

events.title: China TiO2 prices held at lows as high operating rates meet off-season
events.summary: SMM (18 Nov) reports chloride-process TiO2 at 13,400–16,800 CNY/t and rutile at 11,700–14,000 CNY/t, with high operating rates, weak off-season demand and further softening in titanium concentrate; SMM expects prices to stay under pressure.

events.title: East China liquid epoxy E-51 slips 100 CNY/t
events.summary: Mysteel quotes East China liquid E-51 at 14,900–15,100 CNY/t ex-works on 18 Nov, down 100 CNY/t day on day.

events.title: East China butyl acetate falls 125 CNY/t
events.summary: Mysteel reports East China n-butyl acetate down 125 CNY/t on 18 Nov to 7,350–7,500 CNY/t cash ex-works, following weaker feedstocks.

analyses.summary: AI interpretation: China chloride-process TiO2 remains at 13,400–16,800 CNY/t (mid 15,100) on 18 Nov, unchanged from earlier this week. High operating rates, off-season demand and softer titanium concentrate keep the market under pressure; near-term direction flat to slightly lower.

drivers.name: Operating rates
drivers.note: High producer run rates and inventories

actions.action: Buy hand-to-mouth; no need to pre-buy ahead of December

analyses.summary: AI interpretation: Cost index components were stable on 18 Nov: East China butyl acrylate 10,800 and acrylic acid 9,400 CNY/t (unchanged three days), Shandong styrene 9,810 flat while Jiangsu spot held 10,150-10,250. Styrene futures fell over 2% and a Shandong PO/SM restart adds supply, so the styrene leg (45%) leans softer next week; 2-EHA was not refreshed.

drivers.name: Styrene
drivers.note: Futures down >2% on 18 Nov; new PO/SM supply

actions.action: Hold styrene-acrylic emulsion orders short; expect softer offers late November.

analyses.summary: AI interpretation: Pure-acrylic cost index was flat: BA 10,800 and AA 9,400 CNY/t (18 Nov), MMA 99.9% 9,500 (17 Nov). Falling propylene futures cap upside for acrylates near term.

AI interpretation: Mysteel put East China E-51 at 14,900-15,100 CNY/t on 18 Nov, down 100 on the day and about 300 below early November. BPA (~10,620-10,750) and ECH (~10,950-11,000) are steady, so the drift lower reflects weak demand rather than cost; expect sideways-to-soft prices next week.

actions.action: Negotiate small cuts; avoid forward buying beyond 2-3 weeks.

analyses.summary: AI interpretation: No dated E-20 print found; the app estimates E-20 from E-51 (15,000 on 18 Nov, so model ~14,800). Mysteel's Huangshan E-12 (a different grade) eased to 14,400-14,600, consistent with a softer solid-resin market.

actions.action: Ask suppliers to pass through the E-51 decline.

analyses.summary: AI interpretation: Components: xylene 7,000 CNY/t (-33, 18 Nov), MMA 9,500, BA 10,800, HEMA 97% 14,300 and styrene 9,810 all flat. The index is marginally lower on xylene; weaker futures for styrene and PX point to slight further easing.

actions.action: Keep cover short; next re-quote in two weeks.

analyses.summary: AI interpretation: Jiangsu first-grade soybean oil fell to 8,840 CNY/t on 18 Nov (8,890 on 17 Nov, 9,010 on 16 Nov), PA held 9,800 and no dated 200# white-spirit print was readable today. Lower soybean oil (48% weight) pulls the index down; palm oil on Bursa was also soft.

actions.action: Delay alkyd buys a week to capture softer oil costs.

analyses.summary: AI interpretation: No dated HDI biuret print and no readable HDI monomer page today (Mysteel curing-agent page unavailable to this run), so the model cannot be refreshed on HDI. Solvent legs eased: xylene 7,000 and butyl acetate 7,750 (domestic, 18 Nov). Near-term direction for the biuret model is flat.

drivers.name: Solvents
drivers.note: Xylene and butyl acetate slightly lower

actions.action: Keep current HDI-biuret contracts; re-check HDI monomer tomorrow.

analyses.summary: AI interpretation: East China (Shandong) mixed xylene slipped to 7,000 CNY/t on 18 Nov from 7,050 on 16 Nov. PX futures fell over 3% and Brent dropped to $91.95, so the near-term bias is mildly lower.

actions.action: Buy only prompt needs; expect further small declines.

analyses.summary: AI interpretation: East China n-butyl acetate fell 125 CNY/t to 7,350–7,500 CNY/t ex-works on 18 Nov (Mysteel), versus 7,700 in ChemicalBook's 17 Nov Jiangsu index. Inventories are building and feedstock acetic acid is weak (3,840), so further mild declines are likely.

actions.action: Buy only immediate needs; expect lower levels next week

analyses.summary: AI interpretation: No dated S-100# print found; the app estimates it from xylene (7,000 on 18 Nov, model ~7,000). Lower xylene and crude imply a slightly softer S-100# level.

actions.action: Use xylene trend to challenge S-100 offers.

analyses.summary: AI interpretation: No readable 200# white-spirit print today. Mysteel reports Shandong solvent oil weak on bearish fundamentals (national-standard grade 8,200-8,300) and naphtha down 135, so the bias for 200# is lower.

actions.action: Seek lower offers on next white-spirit lot.
